02 — Our Approach
WE SEE
EVERY
RISK

Construction sites are among the most dangerous work environments on the planet. Manual monitoring is limited, inconsistent, and blind to real-time threats.


Our edge-AI framework deploys directly on a Raspberry Pi 4 — no cloud dependency, no latency — delivering continuous, intelligent safety supervision where it matters most.

We combine three detection modules into a single unified system: PPE compliance, environmental hazard detection, and scaffolding risk classification — all processed locally in real-time.


Safety scores are computed per-worker and per-scene, with instant alerts to HSE supervisors the moment a violation is detected.

05 — Technology
BUILT ON
CUTTING
EDGE
Detection Model
YOLOv11s
The small variant of YOLOv11 — anchor-free, C3k2 blocks, decoupled head. ~9.4M parameters, 21.5 GFLOPs. Fine-tuned on our custom datasets via transfer learning from COCO weights.
Edge Hardware
Raspberry Pi 4
Full deployment on embedded hardware with INT8 quantization and resolution optimization. 10.4ms/frame inference. Zero dependency on network connectivity — safety never goes offline.
Safety Score
Multi-Factor Risk
Weighted PPE penalty (helmet=25, vest=15, gloves=15, mask=5) × contextual scaffold coefficient × soft saturation × crowd normalization → single 0–100 safety score.

MODULE 01
01 — PPE Compliance Detection
PERSONAL
PROTECTIVE
EQUIPMENT
The PPE module uses a fine-tuned YOLOv11s model trained on 3,713 annotated images from Roboflow. It detects 8 classes per frame in real-time, assigning each worker a compliance status (SAFE / PARTIAL / VIOLATION) based on helmet and vest presence. Missing helmet penalties are weighted 25 pts, vest 15 pts, with contextual scaffold amplification up to 1.9×.

MODULE 02
02 — Environmental Hazard Detection
ENVIRONMENTAL
HAZARD
DETECTION
The Environmental module detects 7 classes of on-site safety elements across two integrated sub-tasks:

Environmental infrastructure (4 classes) — barriers, cones, danger zones, work signs — trained on 2,538 images using a hybrid dataset combining web-scraped images and Whisk AI-generated synthetic scenes.

Scaffolding risk classification (3 classes) — integrated directly into the environmental pipeline, detecting High Risk, Suspended, and Low Risk scaffolding. When a worker overlaps a scaffold zone (>30% IoU), contextual coefficients of 1.4× (high) or 1.9× (suspended) amplify the PPE penalty automatically.

MODULE 03
03 — Combined System
PPE +
ENVIRONMENTAL
UNIFIED
The combined pipeline runs both detection models simultaneously on every frame — PPE compliance (8 classes) and environmental hazards (7 classes) — producing a unified scene-level analysis. The global performance is computed across all 15 classes, validated on 535 images, with a final mAP@50 of 86.9%, precision 85.9%, recall 86.7%, and inference speed of 10.4 ms/frame on GPU. On Raspberry Pi 4, the system reaches 35–40 FPS with INT8 quantization and input resizing to 640×480.

MODULE 04
04 — Risk Score Engine
MULTI-FACTOR
RISK
ENGINE
A rule-based aggregation engine converts raw detections into a single 0–100 safety score. The formula combines per-worker PPE penalties (max 50 pts), scaffold environment risk (max 35 pts), and crowd density bonus (max 15 pts). Soft saturation prevents extreme values from dominating, and exponential temporal smoothing stabilizes the score in live video streams.

Score Formula
P_base = 25·helmet_miss + 15·vest_miss + 15·glove_miss + 5·mask_miss
C_context = C_scaffold × C_zone_exposure
P_i = 80 × (1 − e^(−P_base × C_context / 80))  [soft saturation]
P_combined = 0.7 × mean(P_i) + 0.3 × max(P_i)
P_final = P_combined × (1 + 0.15 × log(1 + N_workers))
Score = max(0, 100 − P_final)
S*_t = 0.6 × S_t + 0.4 × S*_(t−1)  [temporal smoothing]
Risk Levels
🟢 SAFE (0–0) 🟢 LOW (1–20) 🟡 MEDIUM (21–50) 🟠 HIGH (51–80) 🔴 CRITICAL (81–100)
